t: This is a statue of Queen Victoria at Imperial College London. It was made by Joseph Edgar Boehm, an Austrian-born British sculptor. Boehm is best known for the Jubilee head of Victoria on coinage, and for the statue of the Duke of Wellington at Hyde Park Corner. He kept a large studio in London and was often commissioned by the Royal Family. Victoria was Queen from 1837 to 1901, longer than anyone before her, and her reign gave its name to the Victorian era.
